title: Missing #[forbid(unsafe_code)] at jmap-client crate root
description: crate-jmap-client/src/lib.rs has no #[forbid(unsafe_code)] attribute. The workspace siblings jmap-types and jmap-server both declare #[forbid(unsafe_code)] at their crate roots. jmap-client has no reason to use unsafe (reqwest and tokio_tungstenite do not require it from the caller side). Adding this attribute prevents accidental unsafe introduction and signals the safety posture to auditors.
